fr.elements: Main Residence; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation Near Structure; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the access point during low-visibility or nighttime responses.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway to maintain clear passage for emergency vehicles along its full length.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the structure to keep a clear path for responders moving around the building.
• Clear a designated turnaround area near the residence so fire and emergency vehicles can reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Keep the perimeter fence gate unlocked or install a knox-box style lock so responders can access the property without delay.
• Mark the fence gate location with a reflective sign or marker visible from the driveway approach.
• Remove or trim any landscaping that narrows the driveway width, particularly at turns, to allow large emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a secondary staging area on the open terrain where additional responding units can park without blocking the primary access drive.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Grass Cover; Open Terrain; Long Driveway; Vegetation Along Driveway; Brush Area; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and the building.
• Remove low-hanging branches from scattered trees near the structure so flames cannot climb from ground vegetation up into the tree canopy.
• Cut or mow grass cover close to the structure down to a short height, particularly during dry months.
• Clear brush from the area immediately surrounding the structure to reduce the amount of burnable material close to the building.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so fire vehicles and equipment can pass through without obstruction.
• Cut back shrubs and brush growing along the driveway edges to reduce the chance that roadside vegetation ignites and blocks access.
• Mow or cut grass along the driveway corridor to keep low growth from spreading fire across the access route.
• Keep the full length of the driveway passable by removing any vegetation that narrows the travel lane.
